meta.title: Who Posted It?
meta.blurb: A screenshot says the June party is cancelled, and everybody believes it. But who posted it first? Help Davi find the truth!

p1.title: The Message
text: It was Monday night. Davi was in bed with his phone. Suddenly, the class group chat exploded with messages.

text.msg: 📸 THE JUNE PARTY IS CANCELLED 😢 — forwarded many times

text: First, Davi read the screenshot. Then he read the comments. Everybody was sad. “No party? No corn cake? No [[quadrilha|dança típica da festa junina]]?”
His best friend, Lia, sent him a private message: “Is it true?? I bought a new dress for the party!”
Davi looked at the screenshot for a long time. Was it true? He didn't know.

p1.eventPt: o Davi viu uma mensagem estranha no grupo da turma

p2a.title: Everybody Knows
text: Davi forwarded the screenshot to three groups: his family, his football team and his neighbors. Then he went to sleep.
On Tuesday morning, everybody at school knew. The [[food stands|barracas de comida]] stopped their plans, and the dancers didn't go to the [[rehearsal|ensaio]].
At lunch, Pedro laughed: “No party? Great! No dancing for me!” Pedro always made jokes, and some students looked at him. “Maybe Pedro wrote it,” said a girl.
Davi looked at the screenshot again. Something was strange: it had no date, and the top part was cut.

p2b.title: The Coordinator
text: On Tuesday morning, Davi went to the office of the coordinator, Dona Sônia. He showed her the screenshot.
“Cancelled? No! Nobody told me that!” she said. She looked very surprised.
Then her phone rang. And rang again. And again. Worried families wanted to know about the party.
“Davi, please help me,” said Dona Sônia. “We need to know where this message came from. The party is on Saturday!”

p3x.title: The Clues

text.text: Davi felt bad. He forwarded the screenshot on Monday, and now the whole town believed it. He wanted to fix his mistake.
Davi sat in the library with the screenshot. He wanted to find the truth before Saturday.

text: First, he looked at the time on the message: 7:12 p.m. Then he looked at the top of the screenshot. It was cut, but he saw part of a group name and a small corn: “...ha IFAL 🌽”.
“Quadrilha IFAL!” thought Davi. “It's the dance group!” The leader of the dance group was Mariana.
After that, he remembered something. At 7:12 p.m. on Monday, he saw Pedro at football practice. So Pedro probably didn't write it.

p3y.title: Pedro Is Angry
text: Davi wrote in the class group: “It was Pedro! He hates the quadrilha!” In five minutes, his message had fifty replies.
Then Pedro answered with a photo of the football team. It was from Monday at 7:12 p.m., and Pedro was in the photo, with no phone.

text.msg: Pedro: I was at football practice!! Why did you say that about me? 😡

text: Some students stopped talking to Davi. Lia sent him a message: “You needed proof, Davi. Now what?”

p3z.title: A Team of Two
text: Lia loved mysteries, so she said yes. First, they made a list in a notebook: Who? When? Where?
Then they scrolled up in the class group. They found the first screenshot, on Monday at 7:30 p.m. Caio posted it.

After that, they found Caio at the school gate. He looked nervous. “I didn't write it!” he said. “My cousin Mariana wrote it in the dance group. I'm in the group too, so I took a screenshot and forwarded it to the class!”
“So we need to see the original message,” said Lia.

text: Davi found Mariana at the gym, with the dancers. He showed her the screenshot.
“That's my message!” she said. “But it's only part of it!” She opened her phone and showed him the original:

text.msg: Today's REHEARSAL is cancelled because of the rain. The June party is on Saturday! See you there! 🌽

text: “I sent it at 7:12 p.m.,” said Mariana. “Somebody cut my message, and now everybody thinks the party is cancelled!” She was almost crying.

p4b.title: In the Office
text: Later that day, Davi went to Dona Sônia's office and told her everything.

text.text: Lia went with him, with their notebook full of clues.
Pedro was there too, very angry. Davi looked at the floor.

text: Dona Sônia listened carefully. Then she looked at the calendar. There were only three days before the party.
“The [[food stands|barracas de comida]], the dancers, the families... Everybody thinks the party is cancelled,” she said. “We need to tell the truth, and fast. Will you help me?”

p4c.title: The Group Chat War
text: Davi wrote more messages about Pedro. Pedro's friends answered. Then Davi's friends answered. The class group became a war.
Nobody talked about the party anymore. Everybody talked about the fight, and some messages were really [[mean|maldosas]].
On Wednesday, Dona Sônia saw the messages. She called both boys to her office. She looked very tired.
“This is not about a party anymore,” she said. “This is a problem.”

p4d.title: The Correction
text: Davi, Lia and Caio called Mariana. She sent them a photo of her original message:

text.msg: Today's REHEARSAL is cancelled because of the rain. The June party is on Saturday! See you there! 🌽

text: “The word rehearsal was at the top,” said Caio. “My screenshot cut it! I'm so sorry.”

Then the three friends posted the full message in the class group, with a note: “The party is NOT cancelled!” Some students believed them, but others didn't. “Is this the real message now?” asked a girl.

e1.title: The Party Is On
text: On Wednesday, the school sent an official message to every family: “The June party is NOT cancelled. See you on Saturday!”

text.text: Davi felt a little guilty. On Monday, he forwarded the wrong message. But this time, he helped to fix it.

text: On Saturday, the school was full. There was corn, music and a big [[bonfire|fogueira]]. Mariana's group danced the quadrilha, and everybody clapped.
In the end, Lia pulled Davi's arm. “Come on, detective! Dance with us!”

question.q: What did the school send on Wednesday?

e2.title: Just a Mistake
text: Mariana sent her full message to every group, and Davi forwarded it everywhere. This time, it was the true message.

Later, Davi discovered the whole story. Mariana wrote her message in the dance group. Her cousin Caio took a screenshot there, but his phone cut the top part by accident. Then Caio forwarded it to the class.
“Nobody lied,” said Davi. “It was just a mistake.” On Saturday, the party was full, and Mariana gave Davi a big piece of corn cake.
e2.eventPt: o Davi descobriu a história toda

options: Caio's phone cut the top part by accident

e3.title: The Wrong Suspect
text: The party happened on Saturday, and it was great. But first, Davi had a problem to fix.
In front of the whole class, he said: “Pedro, I'm sorry. You didn't write the message. I was wrong.”
Pedro looked at him for a long time. Then he said: “OK. But next time, look for proof first.” Davi never forgot that.

e3.eventPt: ele pediu desculpas ao Pedro na frente da turma

question.q: What did Davi say to Pedro?

e4.title: Half Empty
text: The true message arrived, but it arrived late. Many families already had other plans for Saturday.
On the night of the party, only half of the students were there. Two [[food stands|barracas de comida]] never came, and the quadrilha danced for a small audience.
It was a nice party, but it was not the big party everybody wanted. On the way home, Davi thought: “A lie travels fast. The truth needs help.”

question.q: How many students came to the party?

e5.title: Part of the Problem
text: Dona Sônia sent an official message, but Davi's screenshot was faster. It was in his family group, his football group and his neighbors' group. From there, it went to hundreds of phones.
On Saturday, many families stayed at home. They saw the wrong message first, and they never saw the correction.
Davi looked at the empty chairs. He didn't write the rumor, but he helped it grow. That night, he deleted it from every group, but it was too late.
e5.event: his forwarded message reached hundreds of phones
e5.eventPt: a mensagem que ele encaminhou chegou a centenas de celulares

question.q: Why did many families stay at home?
options: They saw the wrong message first

e6.title: Really Cancelled
text: The fight in the group chat continued for two more days. Families called the school, and some students didn't want to go to the party with the other side.
On Friday, Dona Sônia made a hard decision. She put a sign on the school gate: “The June party is cancelled.”
This time, the message was true. Davi read the sign again and again. The rumor was a lie, but the fight made it real.
e6.event: the school really cancelled the party
e6.eventPt: a escola cancelou a festa de verdade

question.q: Why did Dona Sônia cancel the party?
options: Because of the fight in the group chat
